description: Weak, noisy layer-0 feature over which columns each side has played in: fires when a large share of my (side-to-move) stones are in column 4 AND a large share of the opponent's stones are in column 1 (either alone does not fire). Opponent stones in column 5 (and 6), and my stones in columns 1/5/6, suppress it. Slightly favoured when I am the first player and the last move was in column 1, 2 or 4; tactics do not matter.
effect: None measurable: steering to max, zero, or 10x max changes no move probability by even 0.01.
notes: Tiny activations (dev max 0.004, threshold 0.001). The minimal pairs agree on the rule (my col-4 share combined with their col-1 share; their col 5 negative), but the best program gets only F1 0.351 (P 0.26, R 0.53, AUROC 0.74). p1 (parity + last col) F1 0.18; linear shares 0.31; min-share conjunction 0.32; counts 0.24. Simulation was nan (no ablation damage). Synthesis reaches the dev max but does not beat it. May be a random direction.
